title: Prefer strict tables in SQLite
summary: This article advocates for using SQLite's strict table mode, which enforces type checking at insert time rather than allowing SQLite's traditional type flexibility that can silently accept mismatched data types.
problem_solved: Traditional SQLite tables silently coerce or accept mismatched data types, leading to subtle bugs that are hard to detect.
why_valuable: Strict tables catch data type mismatches early at the database level, preventing bugs from silently propagating through applications.
